subject: US Q3 Pulse: OKR course corrections, scope trims, and dependency RAID
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Emma Clarke <emma@greenleaf.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenleaf.ai
Date: 2026-07-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: US Q3 Pulse: OKR course corrections, scope trims, and dependency RAID

Team / Emma,

Quick mid-quarter pulse and asks so leadership and GreenLeaf are aligned ahead of the July 30 demo and our QBR packet. TL;DR: we need to tighten scope on two OKRs, surface three critical dependencies (infra, security sign-off, procurement), and confirm owners for QBR artifacts by EOD Friday (7/24).

Status snapshot (attached OKR_heatmap_v2.xlsx):
- Serving runtime (OKR-RT): yellow — functional but latency spikes on long sequences; current plan exceeds our cost target without batching tweaks.
- Model rollout (OKR-MR): green/amber — model v2 ready but needs quantization validation.
- Integrations (OKR-INT): red — external end-to-end tests blocked by integration test availability and a pending security review.

Immediate asks (owners in parentheses):
1) Scope trim proposal: reduce throughput target for OKR-RT to 70% of original baseline for Q3 to keep latency SLOs intact (Vivek).
2) Infra short-term relief: provide a 2-week burst pool allocation for demo (Laura).
3) Security/Procurement: expedite security questionnaire and PO routing (Monica / Emma).
4) QBR artifact owners: slide deck + one-pager (Ben/Monica). Please upload finalized slides to the Drive link in related_links.

Attachments: OKR_heatmap_v2.xlsx, QBR_pack_template.pptx

Requested confirmations by 7/24 COB so we can finalize the QBR pack and lock demo scope.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Emma Clarke <emma@greenleaf.ai>
Date: 2026-07-22T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: US Q3 Pulse: OKR course corrections, scope trims, and dependency RAID

Ben — thanks for the signal. I pulled a quick capacity sketch (attached serving_capacity_estimate.csv). Key notes:
- We can open a 2-week burst pool starting 7/27 if we shift one reserved node from internal batch jobs to demo capacity; that will add ~25% throughput headroom.
- Long-run trade-off: we either accept the scope trim Vivek suggests or commit to a larger monthly spend.

Ask: Vivek / infra team, can you confirm which latency-sensitive routes to prioritize for the burst pool? I recommend prioritizing customer-facing generation endpoints and the demo route Emma will hit.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Emma Clarke <emma@greenleaf.ai>
Date: 2026-07-23T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: US Q3 Pulse: OKR course corrections, scope trims, and dependency RAID

On Wed, Jul 22, 2026 at 09:12 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick mid-quarter pulse and asks so leadership and GreenLeaf are aligned ahead of the July 30 demo and our QBR packet.

Agree with the proposed scope trim. Concrete plan from infra:
- Apply scope trim to OKR-RT immediately (reduce throughput target to 70% baseline) — saves ~18% token cost while preserving 95th percentile latency.
- Allocate burst pool as Laura suggested for 7/27–8/09. I'll drop in autoscale-policy-proposal.md with the exact policy.
- Prioritized routes for burst pool: /v1/generate (customer-facing), /v1/chat/demo-route (GreenLeaf demo).

Risk: KV cache warmup for long sequences still causes brief spikes; mitigation is continuous small-batch warmups starting 7/26. We can automate with a short-lived warmup job.

Action items assigned: Vivek (apply policy + warmup job), Laura (configure burst node), Monica (confirm integration windows).

Vivek
VP, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Clarke <emma@greenleaf.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, procurement@greenleaf.ai
Date: 2026-07-24T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: US Q3 Pulse: OKR course corrections, scope trims, and dependency RAID

Ben — appreciate the transparency and the heatmap. A few asks from GreenLeaf before we confirm the demo scope on 7/30:
- Can Redwood guarantee the demo route uptime for the scheduled window (7/30 10:00–11:00 PT)? We need a short SLA statement for that window for our legal team.
- Security: we received a couple of outstanding questions on data retention and audit logs — Monica, can you confirm the timeline for the SOC-related artifacts?
- Procurement: we need an estimated PO amount if we go with the burst pool option so we can fast-track approval.

I can share our procurement worksheet (link: https://greenleaf.ai/procurement/po-templates) if helpful.

Best,
Emma Clarke
Head of Partnerships
GreenLeaf Analytics

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@greenleaf.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-25T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: US Q3 Pulse: OKR course corrections, scope trims, and dependency RAID

Emma — thanks. Confirmations below and next steps:
- Demo SLA: we will commit to 99.5% availability for the demo window (7/30 10:00–11:00 PT). Vivek / Laura to add routing and burst allocation to a pinned policy and share the short SLA blurb by EOD 7/26.
- Procurement estimate: Laura, please provide a PO range for the 2-week burst pool (low / high) by 7/26 so GreenLeaf procurement can route approval.
- Security artifacts: Monica, can you commit to delivering the SOC-related checklist items we control by 7/29? If not, call out blockers and required signoffs.

I created a shared mutual action plan in the Drive (see related_links). Monica — please captain the integration testing and QBR slide finalization. I'll take the external-facing one-pager and the customer exec slide.

Thanks all — target to lock demo scope and QBR deck by 7/30 morning.

Ben
Director, Sales & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Quick update — integration and security status (attachment: integration-test-plan.md):
- Integration test plan ready; test window requested 7/28–7/29. See attached for test cases.
- Security artifacts: we can deliver audit log extracts and retention summaries by 7/29 AM. Full SOC checklist needs a security approver to sign off on the custom retention config — currently blocked (security reviewer assigned: Priya Natarajan; awaiting approval).
- Blockers: procurement PO ETA is needed to schedule external testing with GreenLeaf sandbox. Laura: can we get the low/high estimate by EOD 7/26? (This will unblock GreenLeaf procurement.)
- Resource ask: to meet the 7/30 lock, I request reallocating two full-time SREs from batch work for 2 weeks to run the warmup and integration smoke tests. This is a short-lived trade but will materially reduce the demo risk.

I updated the QBR slide skeleton in the Drive (final draft pending your comments). Will stand up a 30-min sync tomorrow 7/28 if we need a last-minute run-through.

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
